text: In 1999 the British backpackers Liz and Kristy and their Australian friend Ben [camp at Wolf Creek Crater in the outback|trigger|travelling somewhere remote], and return to find their watches stopped and the car dead. A friendly bushman, Mick Taylor, tows them to his camp at an abandoned mine, swapping tall stories by the fire, then hands them water that knocks them out. Liz wakes bound in a shed beside [a woman's mutilated body|images|corpses and body parts] and finds [a garage stacked with travellers' cameras and belongings|rules|how it hunts].
